description: Diorama (50x50): a river valley between forested level-2 to level-6 terraces; two Deep Ore Veins with Deep Mine sites south and east of the start, Deep Ore Sources with Deep Drill sites on the south-east level-4 bench and the east level-6 terrace, the sandstone quarry on the central level-3 strip and the limestone quarry on the east level-6 terrace, five record caches around the Archive Excavation at the south edge; the Nuclear Reactor fills the forested south level-3 pocket (one low cell takes a platform block), the Deep Processor and Steel Mill sit on the east terraces and the Cryogenic Liquefaction Plant in the level-2 south-west corner.
